cases.name: ephemeral host death by signal: session does not survive
ephemeral clean shutdown: not a death, session still does not survive
durable host crash: abnormal, session survives for explicit recovery
durable config error exit: tidy name, still an abnormal death (no SessionEnd)
unrecognized profile inherits no durable guarantee
spawn failure before any handshake: no profile, no exit evidence

comment: Host-death records: durability profile in force + process exit evidence ({code, signal}, exactly one non-null, as both bridge transports deliver) -> recorded observation. Exit rows follow SS2.11: exit 0 is the only clean row; every other row is an abnormal death. Only a durable profile's session survives its host. at_ms is supplied by the caller and asserted by shape, not value.
